content_zh:
“楚夏，我怎么还没怀孕？你是不是不行？”
大乾宫，祖龙禁地。
一绝美女子坐在浑身染血的少年腿上。
她青丝如瀑，身材曼妙，一双美眸泛著金色的灵韵，神圣中又透露出几分妖异。
楚夏有气无力的撑开眼皮：“我只答应跟你双修，別的概不负责。”
“不行，我必须怀孕才行，继续！”
女人不管不顾，再次欺身压了过来……
楚夏已是强弩之末，无力反抗，只能躺平。
两个时辰后。
地面一片狼藉，衣衫化作碎布，就连坚硬的玉质地砖都以二人为中心，破碎出蛛网状的裂纹。
女人容光焕发，眸中金芒更胜。
但她眉宇间却笼罩一抹愁云，心中似有不甘。
“还是不行，你虽然是纯阳道体，但修为实在太弱，难以跟我的帝阴仙体產生共鸣。”
“不过也不是完全没用，至少我的实力恢復了不少。”
女人名叫姜云芝，是前朝玄阴女帝，五百年前被部下背叛，最终自爆身亡。
但姜云芝並未死去，而是假死脱身，藏匿在皇宫深处的祖龙禁地內，蛰伏起来，伺机报仇。
只是她伤势太重，苦修五百年，也难以恢復实力。
她的帝阴仙体非常特殊，要想完全恢復巔峰修为，必先在体內孕出帝胎，依靠孕期的先天帝气方有一线机会。
只是这皇家禁地危险重重，平日里根本无人敢靠近，偶尔有人误入，也是宫里的太监宫女，派不上用场。
要不是今天突然闯进来一个浑身染血，身受重伤的楚夏，她都打算就此沉睡下去，过个几百几千年再出来。

看著昏睡不醒，气若游丝的楚夏，姜云芝眼里生出一分怜爱。
这就是我姜云芝的男人嘛。
刚才没注意看，现在她才发现，楚夏长得还真不赖。
便宜这小子了。
“醒醒。”姜云芝伸手在楚夏脸上掐了一下。
楚夏昏昏沉沉的睁开眼，下意识道：“来吧来吧，趁我还有一口气在，你赶紧蹂躪我吧，等我死了你就没机会了。”
“谁说你会死。”
“我筋脉尽断，修为全废，浑身有至少七处致命伤，便是神仙来了也难医。”
楚夏神色一黯。
他十八年前胎穿到这个世界，成为天资卓绝，人人羡慕的神武將军府少主。
可自从父亲战死沙场，他的身份一落千丈，从前身边的好人，也一个个相继露出最丑恶的嘴脸。
包括他的未婚妻，大乾六公主夏蓝曦！
为了除掉自己，夏蓝曦甚至动用了龙渊卫追杀他。
楚夏怎么也想不到，曾经跟在自己屁股后面口口声声喊著此生非他不嫁的女孩，如今却要取他性命！
“放心吧，你现在是我姜云芝的男人，我不同意，谁也不能夺走你的性命。”
一双温柔的纤纤玉手抚过楚夏的脸颊。
说罢，姜云芝取出一枚遍布金纹的丹药，含在口中，俯身上前吻住楚夏，暗运灵力，將丹药送入楚夏腹中。
但就在姜云芝要分开的时候，她突然感觉心口一震，只见一朵散发出神异光辉的青莲从她心口绽放而出，隨著瓣一片片绽开，一口纯黑色的小鼎显现出来，如瓜熟蒂落般坠下，顷刻间没入楚夏的身躯中消失不见。
“这是……万神鼎！”
姜云芝神色动容。
content_en:
"Chu Xia, why am I not pregnant yet? Are you not good enough?"
Daqian Palace, the forbidden area of the Ancestral Dragon.
A beautiful woman sat on the legs of a young man covered in blood.
She has black hair like a waterfall, a graceful figure, and a pair of beautiful eyes with a golden aura, and there is a bit of enchantment in her sacredness.
Chu Xia weakly opened her eyelids: "I only promise to practice dual cultivation with you, and I will not be responsible for anything else."
"No, I have to get pregnant, keep going!"
The woman ignored her and bullied her again...
Chu Xia was at the end of her strength and unable to resist, so she could only lie down.
Two hours later.
The ground was in a mess, the clothes were turned into rags, and even the hard jade tiles were broken into spider web-like cracks centered on the two of them.
The woman's face was radiant, and the golden light in her eyes was even brighter.
But there was a cloud of sadness hanging between her brows, and she seemed to be unwilling to do so.
"It still doesn't work. Although you are a pure Yang Taoist body, your cultivation is too weak to resonate with my Emperor Yin Immortal Body."
"But it's not completely useless. At least my strength has recovered a lot."
The woman's name is Jiang Yunzhi. She was the former Empress Xuanyin. She was betrayed by her subordinates five hundred years ago and eventually died by suicide.
But Jiang Yunzhi did not die. Instead, he faked his death and escaped, hiding in the Ancestral Dragon Forbidden Area deep in the palace, dormant, waiting for an opportunity to take revenge.
It's just that her injuries were too severe, and even after five hundred years of hard training, she couldn't regain her strength.
Her Emperor Yin Immortal Body is very special. If she wants to fully restore her peak cultivation, she must first give birth to an Emperor fetus in her body. Only by relying on the innate Emperor Qi during pregnancy can she have a chance.
It's just that this royal forbidden area is full of dangers. No one dares to approach it on weekdays. Occasionally, someone enters by mistake, and they are also eunuchs and maids in the palace, so they are of no use.
If Chu Xia hadn't suddenly walked in today, covered in blood and seriously injured, she would have planned to fall asleep and come out again after hundreds or thousands of years.
Looking at the sleepy and angry Chu Xia, Jiang Yunzhi felt a sense of pity in his eyes.
This is my man, Jiang Yunzhi.
She didn't pay attention just now, but now she realized that Chu Xia was really good-looking.
This guy is cheap.
"Wake up." Jiang Yunzhi reached out and pinched Chu Xia's face.
Chu Xia opened her eyes drowsily and said subconsciously: "Come on, come on, while I'm still breathing, you can ravage me quickly. You won't have a chance when I die."
"Who said you would die."
"My muscles and veins are severed, my cultivation is completely disabled, and I have at least seven fatal wounds all over my body. Even if the gods come, it will be difficult for them to heal me."
Chu Xia's expression darkened.
He was reincarnated into this world eighteen years ago and became the young master of the Shenwu General's Mansion with outstanding talents and envied by everyone.
But since his father died in the battlefield, his status has plummeted, and the good people around him have shown their ugliest faces one after another.
Including his fiancée, Xia Lanxi, the Sixth Princess of Daqian!
In order to get rid of him, Xia Lanxi even used the Longyuan Guard to hunt him down.
Chu Xia could never have imagined that the girl who used to follow him and kept saying that he would not marry her in this life would now want to take his life!
"Don't worry, you are now my man, Jiang Yunzhi. If I don't agree, no one can take your life away."
A pair of gentle, slender hands caressed Chu Xia's cheeks.
After saying that, Jiang Yunzhi took out an elixir covered with golden patterns, held it in his mouth, leaned forward and kissed Chu Xia, secretly using his spiritual power to send the elixir into Chu Xia's belly.
But just when Jiang Yunzhi was about to separate, she suddenly felt a shock in her heart. She saw a green lotus emitting magical light blooming from her heart. As the petals bloomed, a pure black small cauldron appeared. It fell like a ripe melon and disappeared into Chu Xia's body in an instant.
"This is... the Ten Thousand God Cauldron!"
Jiang Yunzhi looked moved.
